text:
maya_cs: Quick weekly check-in on Dedicated capacity for AcroHealth — noticed overnight queue depth spikes and a bump in GPU hours compared to last week. Putting raw snapshots below for context.

capacity-bot: ALERT automated: eu-west-pool-3 saturation 92% over last 2 hours, avg queue depth 14.

maya_cs: Raw summary (00:00-08:00 UTC):
```
- total GPU hours: 1824 (+18% w/w)
- top pools: eu-west-pool-3: 92% sat, us-west-pool-1: 76% sat
- avg queue depth: 12.9
- p95 scheduling latency: 480ms
- inference error rate (client-visible): 0.6% (+0.2%)
- spend estimate (projected month): $21.6k (+12%)
```

rajesh_eng: Thanks Maya — do we know if the spike is due to longer seq lengths or more concurrent jobs?

maya_cs: Early look at traces suggests longer seqs on fine-tune experiments plus a few large batched eval jobs from the ML team between 01:30-03:00 UTC.

oliver_sre: Can you drop the logs for scheduled jobs in that window? I want to see queue churn patterns.

maya_cs: Posted job IDs inline: `job_8923`, `job_8924`, `job_8937`. Those correspond to the eval-runner group.

rajesh_eng: I'll check model variants used — if they're running non-quantized variants at scale that explains the GPU-hour jump. CC @jenna_pm for customer-facing note.

jenna_pm: Noted. If this persists we should warn AcroHealth about potential overage and discuss reserved hours uptick before renewal. Want to avoid surprise invoice.

harold_billing: FYI, current committed hours cover ~85% of this month's usage. If the trend continues we'll hit overage ~72 hours before EOM.

oliver_sre: Short-term mitigations:
- throttle low-priority eval jobs between 01:00-04:00 UTC
- pin heavy jobs to us-west-pool-2 if capacity available
- enable prefix KV caching on warm endpoints (might shave token cost)

maya_cs: Action items:
- @rajesh_eng investigate model variants + quantization knobs (ETA today EOD)
- @oliver_sre apply temporary throttle for eval-runner (ETA 30m)
- @jenna_pm prepare a short note for AcroHealth summarizing trend and suggested reserved hours options (ETA tomorrow morning)
- @harold_billing calculate projected overage and a suggested add-on commit (ETA 2h)

rajesh_eng: Acknowledged — will check quantized vs fp16 runs and post findings in thread.

oliver_sre: Throttle applied to eval-runner tag at 15:12 UTC, dropping concurrent jobs by 40%. Monitoring now.

capacity-bot: INFO automated: throttling policy applied to tag eval-runner by user oliver_sre.

maya_cs: Thanks — will re-check queue depth in 2 hours and post updated numbers.

oliver_sre: Quick note on latency — p95 scheduling latency dropped to 320ms after throttle, queue depth down to ~6. Still watching error rate.

maya_cs: Updated snapshot (2h after throttle):
```
- total GPU hours (last 24h): 1670
- avg queue depth: 6.1
- p95 scheduling latency: 320ms
- inference error rate: 0.55%
```

jenna_pm: Good progress. I'll draft the customer note with options: 1) add 200 reserved hours; 2) shift eval windows; 3) help team adopt quantized model variant. Will attach cost delta.

harold_billing: Drafted numbers — adding 200 hours reduces projected overage by ~85% and stabilizes monthly spend around $22.5k. Sending to @jenna_pm now.

maya_cs: Closing loop: monitoring continues, actions in flight. Will post final readout in tomorrow's weekly health summary. :white_check_mark:
